summary: A tonewheel organ firmware modelled on setBfree, with drawbars, percussion and a rotary speaker, for the FM-1 and the M-VAVE SMK-37 Pro keyboard.
features: Full tonewheel chain with drawbars and a drawbar-key mode
Percussion, vibrato and chorus settings V1-V3 and C1-C3
Drive, reverb and a slow, fast or stopped rotary speaker
Separate build for the SMK-37 Pro, whose controls are still being tested
Browser emulator; manual in English and Portuguese
